intent: Prevent repeated declaration processing when this shared GC header is included through multiple public headers.
constraints: The conventional guard surrounds the complete header body.
reason: The conventional include-guard name and matching define already express its complete purpose.

intent: Import common scalar types and macros while keeping state, value, and ownership-control pointer dependencies incomplete.
constraints: The pointed-to types are only needed as pointers in callback signatures and fields.
reason: The include and forward declarations follow ordinary C header dependency rules; their names are sufficient.

intent: Give the shared raw-object header the platform alignment required by GC object storage.
constraints: The alignment value is selected centrally for compiler and platform configuration.
reason: The struct-level contract is documented; the compiler-specific macro mapping belongs in common configuration.

intent: Allow callers to name the tagged raw-object structure without repeating struct.
constraints: This typedef is exactly the struct tag and adds no separate layout or ownership semantics.
reason: The alias is a conventional spelling of the matching struct tag.

intent: Keep small raw-object initialization and status predicates available in the including translation unit.
constraints: Compiler-specific inline behavior is selected by common configuration; callers still need the defining header.
reason: Inline policy is centralized in the shared macro definition and does not need a header-local explanation.

intent: Embed the common header at the start of concrete GC object layouts so raw allocation and typed casts address the same storage.
constraints: Derived types must keep super as the first member when they rely on raw-object base allocation and casts.
reason: Multiple concrete types place SZrRawObject super first, and allocator casts its allocation base directly to SZrRawObject.

intent: Ensure full collection restores its protected-call state when a custom raw-object callback throws.
constraints: If a callback throws through the protected full-GC call, lock, stop-the-world, and GC-end cleanup must still run.
reason: The existing BUG annotation identifies that a thrown scanMarkGcFunction can longjmp over mutation unlock, StopTheWorldEnd, and GcEnd, leaving later mutators blocked.

intent: Describe the custom scan/finalize callback stored on a raw object.
constraints: Callback receives the owning state and raw object; exceptions must follow the GC callback boundary.
reason: The type is used by both mark and release paths, and the header comment records that shared role.

intent: Deliver one externally stored value slot to the active GC operation.
constraints: The visitor is supplied by the collector and userData carries operation-local work state.
reason: The callback signature is documented at the declaration and its mark visitor use is concrete.

intent: Enumerate externally stored GC values for marking, young-reference checks, and forwarding.
constraints: The callback must invoke the supplied visitor for each externally retained value slot while the raw object is valid.
reason: The same callback is consumed by three collector operations with different visitors.

intent: Represent resource construction and drop state in the common raw-object header.
constraints: Resource transitions must reject duplicate dropping and ordinary objects retain NONE.
reason: The enum values correspond to construction, alive, dropping, and dropped checks in ownership and domain-sharing paths.

intent: Provide the shared prefix for every GC-managed runtime object.
constraints: Derived objects must embed this header first; fields are initialized before domain assignment and later updated by GC/ownership code.
reason: The structure comment captures the embedding contract while evidence shows allocation, initialization, domain assignment, and movement guards.

intent: Link objects in the collector's allocation and release lists.
constraints: The link is collector-owned and must not be confused with gcList's work queue.
reason: The field comment distinguishes the object registry/release chain from the GC scanning chain.

intent: Select type-specific mark, forwarding, and release behavior.
constraints: The value must be a valid EZrRawObjectType set during construction.
reason: Collectors dispatch directly on this field, and construction supplies the type before domain registration.

intent: Preserve native versus VM-object classification used by GC and callable binding paths.
constraints: The allocation entry sets it after construction; consumers must read it only while the raw object is live.
reason: The flag is assigned at both allocation variants and branches concrete GC/closure paths.

intent: Mark a resource object temporarily transferred into a GC box.
constraints: Only an alive resource object may be recognized as a GC box; release restores an ownership root before dropping.
reason: Ownership transfer, recognition, and restoration paths directly maintain the flag and resource state.

intent: Store the resource lifecycle represented by EZrResourceLifecycleState.
constraints: Only resource objects should leave NONE; dropping is terminal and repeat calls return without reentering drop.
reason: The ownership resource implementation performs the state transitions and guards duplicate drops.

intent: Carry incremental, generational, region, forwarding, and pin state for the object.
constraints: Construction initializes all sentinel fields; collector transitions own subsequent updates.
reason: The mark aggregate is initialized on allocation and read by mark, relocation, and compaction decisions.

intent: Link temporary GC scanning work lists.
constraints: The collector owns this link and clears or relinks it when an object changes work-list state.
reason: Mark propagation and internal queue helpers use gcList independently of next.

intent: Store an external-value tracer used by multiple GC phases.
constraints: When non-null, the callback must enumerate slots through the supplied visitor; non-null callbacks also prevent old-object evacuation.
reason: Mark, young-reference, forwarding, and evacuation checks all consume this field.

intent: Store custom scan/finalize work for native data and releasable objects.
constraints: The callback is optional; its exception and cleanup behavior must satisfy the surrounding GC boundary.
reason: 实现明确展示标记与释放两类调用，但仓内尚无完整自定义回调实现；核实外部回调如何区分阶段并遵守 GC 异常边界。

intent: Reserve per-object finalizer context while preserving checkpoint eligibility checks.
constraints: Current in-tree callers only initialize it to NULL or require NULL for checkpoint; external finalizer ownership remains unverified.
reason: No in-tree writer or finalizer consumer was found beyond initialization and NULL checks; external ownership and serialization contract need confirmation.

intent: Associate an object with its shared ownership control block.
constraints: The pointer is cleared when the control block finishes; a non-null control block excludes old-object evacuation.
reason: Creation, reverse association, clearing, and compaction exclusion are all visible in the cited paths.

intent: Identify the GC domain that owns the object.
constraints: The id must be checked together with gcDomainGeneration; zero values denote an unassigned object.
reason: Domain assignment, extraction, zero checks, and mark-time identity validation use the field as a pair.

intent: Disambiguate reused GC-domain ids across generations.
constraints: The generation is valid only as the pair with gcDomainId and must match the active domain identity.
reason: Assignment, export, and mark checks compare this generation with the active domain.

intent: Track the registered ownership-root slot for an object.
constraints: Index and generation must match the current domain slot; unregistered objects use the NONE sentinel.
reason: Domain root registration, removal, and slot validation update the paired fields.

intent: Reject stale ownership-root slots after slot reuse.
constraints: The generation must be compared with the slot generation together with ownershipRootIndex.
reason: Registration writes the generation and removal/lookup validates it before touching a root slot.

intent: Provide the hash used for string and object value lookup.
constraints: String construction overwrites the default with content hash; object construction currently initializes from the address of the constructor's parameter slot.
reason: 该字段用于对象值哈希，字符串另行写入内容哈希；默认值问题登记在构造函数单元。

intent: Initialize the common raw-object header before GC-domain assignment and derived-object use.
constraints: The storage must be writable and large enough for SZrRawObject; callers set allocation-specific native, generation, region, and derived fields afterward.
reason: 构造函数把形参变量地址 &super 写成对象默认哈希，而 value.c:265 将该字段用于对象键；同一内联调用点复用形参槽时，不同对象会落入同桶，HashSet_Find/Remove 会逐节点扫描。

intent: Override the constructor default with a stable content hash for strings.
constraints: Call only after the raw object exists; the supplied hash must remain consistent with the string contents used by equality.
reason: Both string allocation paths use this helper before hash-table insertion and value hashing reads the field.

intent: Recognize the initial incremental mark state.
constraints: The caller must pass a live raw object whose mark status has been initialized.
reason: Mark preparation and tests use the helper to branch on the initialized status.

intent: Recognize an object queued for scanning.
constraints: The caller must pass a live raw object and interpret the result only within the collector state machine.
reason: 仓内仅见 GC 状态测试直接调用此内联谓词；生产 GC 路径直接检查或转换状态，注释只陈述该谓词的输入和返回语义。

intent: Recognize an object already marked reachable.
constraints: The caller must pass a live raw object and respect the current GC cycle's status transitions.
reason: Mark propagation assertions and concurrent-major tests exercise the predicate.
